name: march-ext
description: Sketch backend and frontend architecture on a canvas -- drag typed shapes or hand-draw them -- and generate real, runnable code from it via your own coding agent CLI, whichever one you point it at.

march.agentArgs.description: Flags for Autodiscover's one-shot, non-interactive agent run (it needs a real exit code, unlike Generate's interactive session). Empty by default -- there's no set of flags that works across different agent CLIs (a non-interactive/print flag, a permission mode, an output format are all agent-specific), so this needs to be set for whichever CLI your project's agent binary (set per-project, not here -- see the Agent field in March's nav panel) points at before Autodiscover will run.
